name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: The time left until a moment, as text that counts down ("4 min 12 s"), announced to screen-reader users only at the moments the project lists.

meta.when: Something the person holds for a limited time: a reserved seat, a price that is kept, a code that expires, a session about to end. Say what happens at the end and offer a way to get more time beside it. Not for decoration or pressure: a countdown that restarts or means nothing is a dark pattern. For progress through a known amount of work use progress.
meta.example: Your seats are held for{" "} `${left} left to finish booking`} onExpire={release} expiredLabel="no longer: the hold has ended" />
